findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "kyc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x402_pay_guard, get_trial_key, china_supplier_check, domain_check, supplier_invoice_check, self_hosted_wallet_evidence, x402_payee_check, eu_company_check, kyc_check · Private data: x402_pay_guard, get_trial_key, eu_vat_check, eu_sanctions_screen, eu_sanctions_batch, us_trade_screen, china_supplier_check, us_company_lookup, company_lookup, eu_sanctions_wallet, eu_tenders_search, nl_insolvency_check, pep_screen, pep_batch, domain_check, iban_check, peppol_lookup, supplier_invoice_check, eu_eori_check, email_verify, phone_verify, self_hosted_wallet_evidence, watch_30_days, x402_payee_check, company_dossier, company_health, eu_company_check, kyc_check · Public sink: get_trial_key, domain_check, peppol_lookup, supplier_invoice_check, email_verify, phone_verify, watch_30_days, kyc_check · Destructive: phone_verify.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
